items.title: Corey Kiner: First career TD in loss
items.text:
Kiner rushed eight times for 55 yards and a touchdown and returned nine kickoffs for 224 yards in the Patriots' 45-27 loss to the Packers on Sunday.

items.title: Tucker Kraft: Single-digit yardage on three touches
items.text:
Kraft brought in one of three targets for one yard and rushed twice for eight yards in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots on Sunday.

items.title: DeMario Douglas: Exceeds century mark in loss
items.text:
Douglas brought in five of nine targets for 102 yards in the Patriots' 45-27 loss to the Packers on Sunday.

items.title: Gardner Minshew: Sparse output in first Arizona start
items.text:
Minshew was 21-for-30 passing for 166 yards, no touchdowns and no interceptions and had a four-yard carry during Sunday's 17-3 defeat in Seattle.

items.title: Tyler Allgeier: Accrues 19 touches Sunday
items.text:

items.title: Woody Marks: Logs 19 more touches in Week 9
items.text:
Marks turned 18 carries into 70 yards and hauled in just one of four targets for four yards during Sunday's 44-22 road win over the Chargers.
